Installed versions of packages

Source: R/refresh-snapshot.R
package_versions.Rd

Usage

package_versions(packages)

Arguments

packages

character Package names.

Value

list Named by package; each element has version and remote_sha (both NA when unknown or not installed).

Details

Records the version and RemoteSha (set when installed from GitHub, e.g. with pak or remotes) of each package. Pass the result to write_snapshot_json(packages = ) to record which package versions built a snapshot, or call it from a keep_fresh() checker and store the result in its state to decide whether the data needs checking again (e.g. skip a remote lookup until installed packages change).

See also

Other refresh: fresh_digest(), fresh_fingerprint(), fresh_inputs_hash(), read_snapshot(), write_snapshot_json()

Examples

package_versions(c("gsm.core", "not.a.package"))
#> $gsm.core
#> $gsm.core$version
#> [1] "1.3.2.9000"
#> 
#> $gsm.core$remote_sha
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> 
#> $not.a.package
#> $not.a.package$version
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $not.a.package$remote_sha
#> [1] NA
#> 
#>
